$comment: Deployment inputs for the Hosted Agent version, held as data so a deploy is
a reviewable diff rather than a set of remembered flags.
CONSUMED BY foundry_agent_lab.hosted_deploy, which builds a
HostedAgentDefinition from it. Every field maps to one the installed
azure-ai-projects 2.5.0 model declares — verified by introspection and
asserted by tests rather than trusted.
ARCHITECTURE. The image must be linux/amd64. Foundry runs Linux amd64 nodes,
and an arm64 image built on an Apple Silicon workstation will push happily
and then fail to start with an exec format error. The build command in the
README passes --platform for exactly this reason.
NO SECRETS. environment_variables carries endpoints and names only; the
container authenticates with the managed identity Foundry assigns it, and
the registry issues no credentials because its admin account is disabled.
RESOURCE TIERS ARE PAIRS. Foundry accepts 0.25/0.5Gi, 0.5/1Gi, 1/2Gi and
2/4Gi, and REJECTS every other combination - '1' with '4Gi' is not a tier
even though both values appear in the table. Change cpu and memory
together; hosted_deploy.RESOURCE_TIERS enforces the pairing.
NO PORT. Foundry reserves PORT and injects it; azure-ai-agentserver-core
resolves the bind port from it, defaulting to 8088, and binds 0.0.0.0.
Declaring PORT here would fight the platform for the bind address.
IMMUTABLE IMAGE TAG. The image below is the CORRECTED artefact deployed as
version 2: it installs at /app so the editable-install .pth files stay
resolvable, and it carries the approved corpus. It superseded the version 1
image, which failed every session with 'No module named hosted_agent'.
The tag is treated as immutable - it names one build and is never moved.
Any behaviour change is a NEW tag and a NEW version, never a re-push over
this one, because a moved tag makes a deployed version unreproducible.
Rebuild, run scripts/container_smoke.sh, then update this tag: the smoke
test is the gate, and version 1 is what shipping without it looks like.
description: The Phase 18 controlled agent, hosted by Microsoft Foundry.
